summary.method: EPA AVERT Web v4.3.0 numerical replay with pinned original source and input data
summary.signConvention: Model deltas are scenario minus baseline. A requested terminal reduction is recorded as positive MWh.
summary.aggregation: Modeled regional deltas sum monthly post-minus-original results from the original AVERT client aggregation.
